intro.zh: 固定长度、长上下文、前缀缓存和 Agent 回放；采用原生混合精度权重。
intro.en: Fixed-length, long-context, prefix-cache and Agent replay measurements with native mixed-precision weights.

note.zh: 各性能点为单次批次观测；未做任务精度评估，不能推断长期稳定容量。Agent C8 的 437 轮中 23 轮达到 512 输出上限。
note.en: Each point is a single batch; task accuracy was not assessed and sustained capacity is not established. At Agent C8, 23 of 437 turns reached the 512-token output cap.

intro.zh: 下表为报告中的代表性实测点；C 表示客户端并发。
intro.en: Representative measured points from the report; C denotes client concurrency.

notes.zh: 133120 总窗口下实测 8 条满长请求同时驻留、零抢占。约 128K 前缀的冷 TTFT 为 14.636 秒，热组中位数 0.771 秒；缓存条件不同。
notes.en: Eight full-window requests resided concurrently without preemption at a 133,120-token total window. At approximately 128K prefix, cold TTFT was 14.636 s and warm median 0.771 s under different cache conditions.

methodIntro.zh: 不同负载、缓存状态和测量分母应分别解读。
